summary: Iteration 3 — Multi-wall batch, diagram labels and 'z bloczka' source all PASS. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (added TestWallProjectField: POST /api/walls accepts optional 'project' field and persists it via GET; default empty string when omitted; aliased _id never leaks). Frontend (390x844): (1) Manual 344×266 wall with notches (0,259,17,7) and (327,259,17,7) → ALL 6 required cut-group testIDs visible: cut-group-17x7, cut-group-32x14, cut-group-26x14, cut-group-43, cut-group-18, cut-group-25; subtitle text 'z bloczka 50×24' appears 6 times — every cut is sourced from the 50×24 big block. (2) WallDiagram: 19 diagram-cut-{course}-{i} testIDs rendered including top-course corners diagram-cut-11-0 and diagram-cut-11-8 (17×7 notch pieces) AND the hidden 18 cm cuts on even rows (diagram-cut-10-7, diagram-cut-8-7 …); labels visible: '17×7', '32×14', '26×14', '25', '18', '43'. ScrollView horizontal applied for wide walls (MIN_SCALE=1.6). (3) Multi-wall flow: on result page add-wall-button → add-manual-button → edit screen → fill 320×301 → calculate-button → navigates BACK to result showing both draft-wall-0 & draft-wall-1 and the project-total box; total-cut-group-19 reads 'z bloczka 50×24 × 6' (count 6 as expected). draft-edit-1 opens edit and returns, draft-remove-1 removes wall and project-total disappears (only draft-wall-0 remains). (4) Save: with 2 walls, save-wall-button label is 'ZAPISZ WSZYSTKIE' → navigates to Historia; both walls appear named 'Ściana' with 'Projekt 14.10.2026 (2 ścian)' subtitle. With 1 wall label is 'ZAPISZ' → navigates to /result?id=... showing stored result (verified via result-wall-dims visible). All APIs returned 200. No react-native issues, no deprecated packages encountered.
action_items: No action items. All requested multi-wall / diagram-label / 'z bloczka' / project-save features verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Wall model: new optional 'project' field (default '') is correctly persisted and returned; by_alias handling continues to hide Mongo _id.

calc.ts: in segmentPieces every short piece (len < b) OR piece with explicit h (notch/top-cut) is marked isCut and attributed to 'from = blockHeight' (50×24) — matches spec 'every cut comes from the big block'. Only full top-course bricks keep from = plan.t (low brick 9/14/19).
WallDiagram.tsx: cut labels now visible (fontSize 9, mono) and MIN_SCALE=1.6 forces horizontal scroll on long walls so every narrow 17 / 18 / 25 piece has room for its label.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — unchanged from iteration 1 (not blocking).
